critique: The alternating lapis, vermilion, emerald, and gold concentric bands—especially the interlaced lozenge chains and radial rays—boldly fulfill the hypnotic geometry while preserving a luminous parchment ground. The plain double fillet, four simple corner roundels, and nearly invisible guinea-pig marginalium leave the border far less ornate than the central rosette, weakening the illuminated-manuscript identity and the requested moderate overall density.
